"Impure" (tamei) is too negative — not a punishment

Explains that calling someone 'impure' (tamei) is too negative: it simply means not allowed while in service to God's manifestation (e.g. entering the Temple, eating sacrificial foods). One can become impure by doing a mitzvah such as tending a dead person or giving birth; no wrongdoing is implied and it is not a punishment.
